mechanism: Triamcinolone (corticosteroid) may impair vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis and reduce vitamin K absorption, potentially decreasing anticoagulant effect if vitamin K is used for warfarin antagonism or increasing bleeding risk if used therapeutically.
action: Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR) if patient is on concurrent warfarin therapy; ensure adequate vitamin K intake during prolonged triamcinolone use; consider vitamin K supplementation if deficiency risk is elevated.
